protocol: Read and hash the current catalog before every effect.
Derive each feature ledger digest from the canonical progress payload.
Never UPDATE or DELETE existing workflow/event rows; append-only history must remain intact.
For legacy workflows, preserve the original payload and record an explicit unbound status.
Create only revision-bound successor workflow records through the Sa-plan workflow API, with deterministic idempotency keys.
Read back every successor input and require both digests to match the current catalog and ledger bytes.
Re-run the database census, MCP feature status, risk preflight, and independent release checks before any completion receipt.
authority_boundary: No database mutation, workflow start, task claim, task completion, coordinator cutover, deployment, or admission was performed.
